row: Retired Air Force Colonel Spence Cocanour offers free help through Asheville Tree-Top Cat Rescue, rescuing cats from trees. He went from being a Special Tactics Officer trained as a Combat Controller working special operations and personnel recovery with Air Force Special Operations Command to personal recovery of cats.
